capabilities: chat with a self-hosted LLM server from a sidebar with persistent history and streaming
read, search, create, append and overwrite notes through function-calling tools with confirmation and diff preview
extract text from PDF, DOCX and PPTX files in the vault for the agent
run optional web searches via DuckDuckGo or the Brave Search API
edit selected text inline with AI and accept or reject a word diff
extras: Desktop-only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README covers privacy, network use, known limitations and bundled third-party libraries (pdf.js, fflate) in detail.
intentEvidence: Both plugins share the same core.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI model that can act on vault notes, and no built-in chat works with self-hosted LLM servers.
